embed.studio.title: Tezgah
embed.studio.body1: Tezgah means both the market stall and the workbench — the counter a vendor sells from, and the bench a craftsman builds at. Kitchen Tactics is built at both at once: every rig on the roster is hand-drawn, and the board they fight on is the same stall counter this page stands on.
embed.studio.body2: This is a one-person studio's first release — one of seven fully worked art directions before this one was chosen. What is next is more of that same care, not more of everything at once.
embed.press.tagline: A market-stall auto-battler. Buy ingredients, merge three into one, and let the round cook itself.
embed.press.factReleaseValue: In development — a playable build is on this page now
embed.press.descriptionEn: Kitchen Tactics is a market-stall auto-battler. Buy ingredients, merge three into one, and let the round cook itself. Made by Tezgah, a one-person studio.
embed.press.descriptionTr: Kitchen Tactics, bir pazar tezgahı otomatik-dövüş oyunu. Malzeme al, üçünü birleştirip yükselt, turu kendi kendine pişsin. Tek kişilik bir stüdyo olan Tezgah tarafından yapıldı.
